verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say the Analyst Agent "continuously monitors your business", which implies some autonomous background agent activity. The docs also mention scheduled imports, a first-party form of background automation. Neither shows that users can define and configure their own autonomous automations. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation or workflow builder, triggers/schedules for agent actions beyond data imports, details on how background agent runs are set up and monitored, independent or hands-on corroboration.
